SELECT sc.CONFIG_ID, DICT_CODE, CONFIG_VALUE FROM BOK_SCHEME_CONFIG sc LEFT JOIN BOK_SCHEME_CONFIG_VAL scv ON scv.CONFIG_ID = sc.CONFIG_ID AND scv.SCHEME_ID IN ( SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} ) WHERE sc.SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType}
AND sc.CONFIG_ID = #{configId}
